dataflowSinks.script:
sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	input(
		{CRIS No} as integer,
		Accession as string,
		{Ref Src} as string,
		Site as string,
		{Request Date} as date,
		{Event Date} as date,
		{Event Time} as string,
		{On Call} as string,
		PT as string,
		Examination as string,
		{Exam Name} as string,
		Room as string,
		{Start Time} as string,
		{End Time} as string,
		{Exam Key} as integer,
		{Event Key} as integer,
		{Status Code} as string,
		{Booked Date} as timestamp,
		{Booked Time} as string,
		{Creation Date} as timestamp,
		Attended as string,
		Urg as string,
		Modality as string,
		{No of Proc} as integer,
		{Planned Appointment Date} as timestamp,
		{Date First Verified} as timestamp,
		{Time First Verified} as string,
		{Was Planned} as string,
		{Was Scheduled} as string,
		{Was Waiting} as string,
		{Stat Date} as timestamp,
		{Reported By} as string,
		Rank as integer,
		{Age At Event} as string,
		{Status Code.2} as string,
		{Status Date.1} as timestamp,
		{Status Time} as string,
		Modality2 as string,
		{Trust Name} as string,
		Patient_Type as string,
		{Tat Type} as string,
		{Activity.1} as integer,
		{Count of Activty_Demand for Activity.1} as long,
		{ExamSite Code} as string
	),
	deletable:false,
	insertable:true,
	updateable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	truncate:true,
	format: 'table',
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	errorHandlingOption: 'stopOnFirstError') ~> UserQueryAzureSqlCOREStageStep2

Select *
	  ,[WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]+[WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+[WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+[WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]+[WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]+[WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]+[WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]+[WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]+[WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]+[WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]+[WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]+[WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]+[WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]+[WEEKS_13PLUS] as [Calc_total_WL]
	  ,[WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7] + [WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]+ [WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]+ [WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10] + [WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11] + [WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12] + [WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13] + [WEEKs_13PLUS] as [Over 6 Weeks]
	  ,[WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1] + [WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+ [WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+ [WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4] + [WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5] + [WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6] as [Under 6 Weeks]
	  ,Cast(Case when [TOTAL_WL] <> 0 then cast(([WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1] + [WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+ [WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+ [WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4] + [WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5] + [WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]) as float)/Cast([WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]+[WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+[WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+[WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]+[WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]+[WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]+[WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]+[WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]+[WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]+[WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]+[WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]+[WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]+[WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]+[WEEKS_13PLUS] as float) else 0 end as float) as percentage
From (SELECT [PROVIDER_ORG_CODE]
      ,[PROVIDER_ORG_NAME]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS_SORT_ORDER]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS]
      ,SUM([WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]) as [WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]
      ,SUM([WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]) as [WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]
      ,SUM([WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]) as [WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]
      ,SUM([WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]) as [WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]
      ,SUM([WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]) as [WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]
      ,SUM([WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]) as [WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]
      ,SUM([WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]) as [WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]
      ,SUM([WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]) as [WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]
      ,SUM([WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]) as [WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]
      ,SUM([WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]) as [WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]
      ,SUM([WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]) as [WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]
      ,SUM([WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]) as [WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]
      ,SUM([WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]) as [WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]
      ,SUM([WEEKS_13PLUS]) as [WEEKS_13PLUS]
      ,SUM([TOTAL_WL]) as [TOTAL_WL]
      ,SUM([WAITING_LIST_ACTIVITY]) as [WAITING_LIST_ACTIVITY]
      ,SUM([PLANNED_ACTIVITY]) as [PLANNED_ACTIVITY]
      ,SUM([UNSCHEDULED_ACTIVITY]) as [UNSCHEDULED_ACTIVITY]
      ,SUM([TOTAL_ACTIVITY]) as [TOTAL_ACTIVITY]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR]
	  ,cast(CONCAT('01','/',[Z_SNAPSHOT_MONTH],'/',[Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR]) as date) as SnapShotDate
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_YEAR]
      ,[Z_LATEST_SNAPSHOT]
      ,[z_load_date]
      ,[z_snapshot_filename]
    FROM [Unify].[NAT_DM01]
  Where PROVIDER_PARENT_ORG_CODE in ('Q75','Qyg')
  and Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR >=2019
  Group by [PROVIDER_ORG_CODE]
      ,[PROVIDER_ORG_NAME]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS_SORT_ORDER]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS]
	  ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_YEAR]
      ,[Z_LATEST_SNAPSHOT]
	  ,[z_load_date]
      ,[z_snapshot_filename]) as Base

SELECT [Trust ID]
		,[Modality ID]
      ,[Tat Type ID]
	  ,[Exam ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Exam Urgency]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=12 and [Image-Report Hours]<=4 then 1
			when [Tat Type ID]=11 and [Image-Report Hours]<=12 then 1 
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H/12H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=12 or [Tat Type ID]=11 then 1 
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H/12H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when ([Tat Type ID]=12 or [Tat Type ID]=8)  and [Image-Report Hours]<=4 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when ([Tat Type ID]=12 or [Tat Type ID]=8) then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=11  and [Image-Report Hours]<=12 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 12H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=11  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 12H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=3  and [Image-Report Hours]<=24 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 24H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=3  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 24H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=7  and [Image-Report Days]<=28 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 28D Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=7   then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 28D Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=6  and [Image-Report Days]<=3 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 3D Pass]
	 ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=6  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 3D Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=9  and [Image-Report Days]<=7 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 7D Pass]
	 ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=9  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 7D Report]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Where [Datetime First Verified] is not null
  Group by [Trust ID],[Modality ID]
      ,[Tat Type ID]
	  ,[Exam ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Exam Urgency]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]

SELECT [Trust ID]
	,[Modality ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]
	  ,[Date First Verified]
	  ,Avg([Request-Report Hours]) as [Avg Request-Report Hours]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Where [Datetime First Verified] is not null
  and [Patient Type ID]=4
  and [Request-Report Hours] >0
  Group by [Trust ID]
	,[Modality ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]
	  ,[Date First Verified]

SELECT [Modality ID]
      ,[Status ID]
      ,[Trust ID]
      ,Sum(Case when [Activity]=0 then 1 else 0 end) as Backlog
	  ,Sum([Activity]) as Activity
      ,[Request Date]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Group by [Modality ID]
      ,[Status ID]
      ,[Trust ID]
      ,[Request Date]

select [Trust ID]

SELECT [Event Key]
	,[Request Date]
	,[Event Date]
	,[Request-Image Days]
	,[Date First Verified]
	,[Image-Report Days]
	,Activity
	,[Trust ID]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Where [Exam ID]=1465 and [Planned Appointment Date] is null and [Was Planned]='n'

select [Event Key]
,left(Accession,3) as trust
,Count([Event Key]) as [partially reported exams]
,[Site]
,[Request Date]
,[Event Date]
,[PT]
,[Examination]
,[Room]
,[Exam Key]
,[Modality]
FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE]
where [Event Key] in(
SELECT [Event Key]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE]
  where [Date First Verified] is null
  ) and [Event Key] in(
SELECT [Event Key]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE]
  where [Date First Verified] is not null)
 and [Date First Verified] is null
 and Attended = 'Y'
 group by  [Event Key],left(Accession,3),[Site],[Request Date]
      ,[Event Date],[PT],[Examination],[Room],[Exam Key],[Modality]
 order by [Event Key]

	  ,[Request Month Number Only]
      ,[Trust ID]
      ,[Updated Modality]
	  ,[Patient Type ID]
      ,[Referral Source ID]
	  ,Count([Request-Image Days]) as [Count]
      ,Avg([Request-Image Days]) as [Avg Request-Image Days]
      ,Avg([Request-Image Hours])  as [Avg Request-Image Hours]
       FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]

	   and [Request Year Only]>2019
